scope: Text-judgment eligibility only; deterministic wire, state and negative-control evidence is planned separately and remains unavailable.

entries.statement: An adopter uses the documented replacement boot path and existing fbq calls with native `fbevents.js` absent. Pre-ready and post-ready init/PageView calls traverse capture, ordered serialized chamber processing and mediated dispatch; the report distinguishes worker execution from attempted and actual wire.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: The pinned native bootstrap's applicable callable/queue/alias, duplicate installation and readiness behavior is reproduced under identical inputs. Argument snapshot/mutation, ordering, repeated init and return/error behavior are observed, not inferred from an empty queue or a published bootstrap alone.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: The PageView comparison applies spec C1-C9: complete requests/responses and browser/DOM effects, including dependency/configuration traffic. New/private fields are classified and owned, not omitted. Initialization alone is not assumed to generate the explicitly requested PageView.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: Default-on and exact `meta-pixel=off` policy are preserved on the owned setup. An exact duplicate off suppresses Meta initialization even beside another value. Pair these negatives with a qualified enabled positive; two silent profiles cannot pass. No persistent opt-out or consent API is invented.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: Removing a PageView, adding an extra send, altering the Pixel/URL/value, blocking runtime/configuration, disabling the observer and substituting the known empty reference each fails or becomes inconclusive as appropriate. HTTP 200, callable fbq, one Pixel record and owner Test Events receipt cannot replace the complete independently qualified scenario reference.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: The operator receives per-call/request correlation and a visible held, dropped, denied, unavailable or incomplete explanation without identifiers in public output. No main-thread mapping/hash work, direct-connector shortcut, unrestricted fallback or stable-core signature change is introduced.
entries.rationale: Wire, state, policy or product truth requires independently qualified evidence and is not delegated to text judgment.

entries.statement: With separately approved live evidence, actual official-endpoint dispatch/response and any newly correlated receipt are recorded as separate layers. The historical owner-confirmed receipt stays unpaired and not agent-witnessed; attempts are not upgraded to delivery.
entries.rationale: Only report fidelity to supplied evidence is proposed; a text judge cannot establish dispatch or receipt.
